nexus.title: New Player Random Start (Tech Demo)
nexus.summary: Random starting locations for new characters in 7 Days to Die. Choose a biome or let the mod pick.

website.title: New Player Random Start for 7 Days to Die | Bit Wrecked
website.description: Randomize your new character's starting location in 7 Days to Die. Choose a biome or let the mod pick. By Bit Wrecked.

meaning: New Player refers to a fresh character. The world can be new or existing; this name does not promise easier difficulty.
requirements: Windows PowerShell 5.1; local single-player; tested target V3.3.0 b17; Navezgane or Random Gen worlds of 8192 or larger; EAC disabled with supplied 0_TFP_Harmony.
firstSession: Complete the opening tasks and wait for the Journey to Settlement trader marker before leaving the first Random session.
compatibilityNote: The public rename keeps existing HRS installation, state and save identities.
gameNameHelp: Use the save's exact Game Name, not the world name.
usageScope: A fresh character in a supported new or existing world. Random placement happens on its first spawn and does not relocate already-played characters on reload.
